Real official documents from the BVMAC (Bourse des Valeurs Mobilières de l'Afrique Centrale),
Bulletin officiel de la cote, listed on https://www.bvm-ac.org/bulletin-officiel-de-la-cote-boc/,
retrieved 2026-10-04. Published with the BVMAC's written authorisation (free, no resale).

Each PDF is kept as two text files, cut after the bond characteristics table ("Total des encours"
line; the raw files are cut at the same point or 160 lines after the "LIGNES OBLIGATAIRES" header):
  <name>.layout.txt  = `pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8` output (pages separated by form feeds)
  <name>.raw.txt     = `pdftotext -raw -enc UTF-8` output
The PDFs themselves (1.3–1.8 MB each) are not stored.
